newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Hitachi Zosen to build four ships.
newsitem.headline: Hitachi Zosen to build four ships.

text.p: Hitachi Zosen Singapore Ltd said on Thursday it had won contracts to build four ships worth approximately Singapore $100 million.
The deals were not expected to have any material impact on the earnings per share or the net tangible assets per share of the company for the year ending March 31, 1997, it said.
Hitachi Zosen Singapore Ltd is an affiliate of Japan's Hitachi Zosen Corp.
The company said in a statement the vessels -- 19,150-dwt single screw diesel driven multi-purpose dry cargo/container carriers -- would be sold to buyers nominated by Clipper Shipping Ltd.
It said it had also agreed an option with Clipper for the construction of a further two vessels of the same type.
The delivery of the first two vessels would take place in 1998 and the remaining two vessels would be delivered in 1999, the statement said.
It said the contracts had been signed in line with its plan to establish shipbuilding as one of its core businesses.
